name: crew-progress
description: Agents panel (/crew) with the main session's own row (model, effort, context, estimated cost, time) and a pixel-crab costume per workflow profile, plus the progress bar above the prompt. A fork of savvy-progress by johnnyvizz (MIT).

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en, ru or he (Hebrew, drawn right to left)

autoOpen.title: Open the agents panel
autoOpen.description: any: when any subagent starts or a plan is reported; savvy: only for savvy-flow workers and reported plans

openAtStart.title: Open at start
openAtStart.description: on: the panel opens when a session starts. off: it opens only per autoOpen or /crew.
